name: quantity-stepper
title: Quantity stepper
description: A quantity control for carts: minus, plus and a typed value, with pack steps, a stock cap, hold to repeat and remove at one.
docs: Controlled (value, onChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). min defaults to 1 and every value is min plus whole steps. stockLimit and max cap it; removeAtMin turns the minus into a trash button that calls onRemove. A press steps when it is released, so a scroll that starts on a button changes nothing; holding repeats, and neither a hold nor a key repeat ever removes the line. busy ignores presses and covers the number with a spinner without changing the size.
